A pound of muscle takes up less space than a pound of fat. And if you’re losing fat while gaining muscle, your weight may barely change.

Meanwhile, your waist could be changing. Your clothes could fit differently. You could be getting stronger.

Give those changes credit.

title: 💪 Rushing your gym sets to keep your heart rate up?
hook: 💪 Rushing your gym sets to keep your heart rate up?
caption:
💪 Rushing your gym sets to keep your heart rate up?

That might be holding your gains back.

🔬 THE SCIENCE OF REST

Old idea: 60-second breaks maximize metabolic stress.

New research says otherwise.

Stretching rest to 3 minutes produces bigger jumps in muscle thickness and maximal strength.

Why? It comes down to volume.

A full 3 minutes lets your energy systems and nervous system reset. That means:

✅ More reps with heavier weight
✅ Proper form held start to finish
✅ More muscle fibers worked before fatigue kicks in
✅ More total work across the session

🏋️ STRENGTH + GROWTH
